_: painted_faces.gd: the only faces the court may wear, by file under assets/portraits/painted (Mac 2026-11-14: a Rembrandt-era hat and lace collar on a medieval court; 'this is medieval age'). Kept: painted before 1500 (sources.json year; the Met's objectBeginDate agrees for its pieces), each looked at: hoods, veils, coifs, caps and bare heads, no ruff, lace collar, brimmed hat or Baroque dress. 20 kept of 199; the 179 later ones are cut from the pool and the folder, and never padded back with later art. A face not on this list is never shown.
